selection: One bounded candidate; at most two corrective rounds for demonstrated failures. No font/style search or historical import in standard CI.

candidate.fill: Three low-alpha stable curved highlights: vary start/end, inclination, vertical spacing and bend by cell index and salt. Retain solid palette interior, outline, small-cell simplification and shared final drawing in preview/waiting/finishing pass.
candidate.toolbar: One vertical column beneath actual palette extent; 44*UI square actions, 4*UI gaps plus group separation. Clip and locally scroll only tools when necessary; visible scrollbar. Remove old bottom wells and tool text. Preserve board rectangle and mini/palette position where safe.
candidate.warning: Non-numeric conditional warning in cleared bottom paper, separate from stress and recovery text.
candidate.title: Original Bakso only while work visible; explicit bundled fallback only for individually missing real title glyphs, no system fallback. Fraunces on other contexts.

coverage.retained: 304 layouts, nine regular plus ten technical sheets; 80 V1 focused/recovery cases, glyphs 1/11/17/40, V2 projection and restart; current core/G1/GP48/H1/ZS2, 500 actions, saves/recovery, six pilots and export per CI policy.
coverage.v3_layout: F01/F02/F08 on 1280x720,1600x900,1920x1080,2560x1440; UI100/125, G/V, work/fit. Actual visible/clipped tool hitboxes, all eight clicks, scroll ends, outside wheel routing, page transitions, recovery.
coverage.v3_drawing: Native F01/F02/F08 whole images and 1:1 grid/five-crossing, adjacent fills, title and tight toolbar; 12/24/fit cells; preview, active stroke checkpoints and final target. Pure geometry fingerprints across redraw, zoom return, page return and fresh process.
coverage.v3_font: All real work titles and each glyph including middle dot and multiplication; actual font bytes and effective title font from downloaded PCK, context switches and no study resources.
negative_controls: old unchanged grid must fail new variation oracle
identical cell textures must fail diversity
changed cell seed must fail stability
uniform fade must fail spatial-build oracle
horizontal or undersized or clipped/unreachable tools must fail layout
numerical zoom/tool text must fail text oracle
wrong/context-leaking font must fail title oracle
coverage.windows: Fresh download for clean final head: both EXEs without args fresh/partial/completed; genuine old writer/new reader; actual embedded PCK, normal/maximized clients, DPI separate from UI100/125, real viewport mouse/scroll/navigation, redo/recovery. Isolated profiles only.

independent_success: Full frame including AA; exact 24/18 UI slots and unchanged clue font; fit then capacity then translation; stable logical hits, no hidden clues in V, minimum five in G. Own pure fill miniature, timing/X/history/save untouched. Native visible style delta required in addition to geometry. No overlap of actual title/nav/rail/recovery ink.
